description: Defines the WebSocketHandshakeStreamBase class, including its nested CreateHelper class, enums for handshake results, and related static methods and members. It serves as a base class for WebSocket handshake stream implementations in the Chromium project.

classes.name: WebSocketHandshakeStreamBase
classes.description: Base class for WebSocket handshake streams, providing enums for handshake results, factory methods for creating protocol-specific streams, and utility functions.

classes.name: WebSocketHandshakeStreamBase::CreateHelper
classes.description: Abstract helper class for creating WebSocket handshake streams for different protocols (basic, HTTP/2, HTTP/3).

methods.name: Upgrade
methods.description: Creates a WebSocketStream after handshake completion; object becomes unusable post-upgrade.

methods.name: CanReadFromStream
methods.description: Indicates if reading from the stream will succeed, even at EOF.

methods.name: MultipleHeaderValuesMessage
methods.description: Generates a message for multiple header values.

methods.name: GetWeakPtr
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the object, invalidated upon destruction.

methods.name: RecordHandshakeResult
methods.description: Records the result of the handshake attempt.
